summary: Continues the current line as far as it is confident. Stays quiet the rest of the time.
limitations: On code it never trained on, it offers something about 1 time in 8, and about 7 in 10 of those are right. Read what it suggests before you keep it.

provenance.corpus: 1,311 C# files from 8 of the owner's public repositories. No private code. No Microsoft model weights or predictions.

evaluation: 1,500 places where ghost text can appear, from 679 files in 8 private repositories it never trained on: offered 12.1%, right when offered 69.2%, 3.7 wrong per 100 requests, 2.0% of characters saved. Version 1.0.0 as first shipped, on the same cases: offered 82.2%, right 1.5%, 81 wrong per 100, 0.4% saved.
